description: GROUPBY with field_headers (S!A<n>:B<n>) and total depth (S!D<n>:E<n>) both lifted beside a filter column that drops rows (T-4028, follow-up of T-4019): position 1 is {0 fh, 1 td} and spends the filter; position 2 holds, as (field_headers, total depth), a blank cell or a ="" cell with #N/A (=NA()), in both argument orders; each with a no-filter control. Each call spills at A<r>; F<r> labels it. Data is gen-m7 07c0c130d894cfe0 Data (as in t3985-groupby-two-lifted-spent-filter).

cells.F1: fh S!A1:B1 {0,a blank cell}, td S!D1:E1 {1,#N/A} | filter col
cells.F4: fh S!A1:B1 {0,a blank cell}, td S!D1:E1 {1,#N/A} | no filter
cells.F7: fh S!A2:B2 {0,#N/A}, td S!D2:E2 {1,a blank cell} | filter col
cells.F10: fh S!A2:B2 {0,#N/A}, td S!D2:E2 {1,a blank cell} | no filter
cells.F13: fh S!A3:B3 {0,empty text (="")}, td S!D3:E3 {1,#N/A} | filter col
cells.F16: fh S!A3:B3 {0,empty text (="")}, td S!D3:E3 {1,#N/A} | no filter
